context: First create a machine-readable target and dependency inventory plus representative behavioral smoke matrix. Select include boundaries by coherent ownership, not line count. Move one domain per reviewable slice and compare inventory and representative command behavior after each move. Keep root orchestration targets where moving them would obscure control flow. Stop if supported Make implementations or help discovery regress.
description: The root Makefile is approximately 2735 lines and mixes testing, quality, platform, release, tracker, and agent/worktree operations. Modularize it only after the platform-manifest and quality-gate contracts are stable. Preserve every public target, help entry, environment propagation rule, shell behavior, and CI entrypoint. This is a responsibility-based extraction, not a target rename or command-modernization project. Recreated 2026-08-08 by adversarial TODO review from makefile-domain-modularization-20260808 to retarget its quality-gate dependency at align-quality-gates-with-actual-policy-20260808; the tracker blocks claims on dependencies that are not done, and a dropped dependency would have gated this item forever.

anti_patterns.dont: Begin before manifest and quality gates stabilize.
anti_patterns.instead: Honor the dependency graph and revalidate baselines first.
anti_patterns.why: Concurrent gate churn creates conflicts and ambiguous regressions.

anti_patterns.dont: Rename targets or modernize commands while moving them.
anti_patterns.instead: Preserve commands exactly and propose later improvements separately.
anti_patterns.why: Behavior changes become indistinguishable from mechanical extraction.

anti_patterns.dont: Split the Makefile only by size.
anti_patterns.why: Arbitrary chunks obscure ownership and dependencies.

preserves.behavior: CI entrypoints continue invoking the same behavior.
Environment variables shell flags exit codes and command ordering remain equivalent.
Every public make target and alias remains available under the same name.
Help output remains complete and discoverable.

prior_art.concept: Current public orchestration and help contract.
Existing pattern for complex logic delegated out of Make recipes.
Completed evidence that Makefile and CI policy can diverge.
